at_a_glance.detail: Labcorp Holdings Inc. reported Q2 2026 revenue of $3.731 billion, surpassing expectations of $3.714 billion, while its reported adjusted EPS reached $3.64.

at_a_glance.headline: Segment KPIs Reflect Solid Growth
at_a_glance.detail: The Diagnostics segment grew 5.5% year-over-year to $2.9 billion, and Biopharma Laboratory Services increased 6.5% to $836 million, supported by a solid book-to-bill ratio of 1.14.

at_a_glance.headline: Full-Year 2026 Outlook Raised
at_a_glance.detail: Management raised its full-year 2026 enterprise revenue growth guidance to a range of 5.4% to 6.3% and boosted adjusted EPS expectations to a range of $18.10 to $18.55.

at_a_glance.headline: Share Buyback Authorization Increased Significant
at_a_glance.detail: Labcorp's Board of Directors authorized a $1.0 billion expansion to its share repurchase program, bringing total remaining buyback capacity to $1.4 billion.

at_a_glance.headline: Strategic Expansion in Genetic Offerings
at_a_glance.detail: The company expanded its precision medicine footprint with advancements in its oncology screening services and the launch of Marker by Labcorp, a consumer genetic health panel.

CERT.summary: Certara reported Q2 2026 revenue of $93.3 million, a modest 1% year-over-year increase, driven by a 4% rise in software revenue ($48.8 million) offset by a 3% decline in services revenue ($44.5 million). Software revenue expanded to represent 53% of total business, up from 40% two years prior.

key_moments.title: Software Revenue Inversion and Growth
key_moments.blurb: Software bookings grew 9% year-over-year to $50.7 million, with trailing 12-month software bookings up 8%. This performance allows management to project full-year software growth at or above the high end of their 0% to 4% target, supported by increased visibility from customer migrations to cloud platforms.

key_moments.title: EBITDA Margin Guidance Shifted
key_moments.blurb: Management adjusted its full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to 29% to 31%, down from the 30% to 32% range provided in May. This update reflects the direct financial impact of the Regulatory and Medical Writing business divestiture and related unallocated overhead rather than deterioration in core operations.

key_moments.title: NVIDIA Partnership and AI Monetization
key_moments.blurb: Certara announced a partnership integrating its next-generation platform with NVIDIA's BioNeMo Agent Toolkit. The collaboration allows AI agents to interface directly with Certara's software system to enhance high-throughput discovery use cases, accelerating drug development decision timelines and expanding monetization models.

key_moments.title: Services Segment Headwinds and Rejuvenation
key_moments.blurb: Services bookings fell 6% in Q2, impacted by the regulatory unit carve-out and previous go-to-market execution errors. Management is replacing the generalist sales framework with a specialist, PhD-led scientific engagement model, which helped expand the total sales pipeline by 27% to 29% year-over-year.

at_a_glance.headline: Certara Misses Top and Bottom Lines
at_a_glance.detail: Certara reported Q2 2026 adjusted EPS of -$0.36, missing the estimated $0.091, while its quarterly revenue of $93,271,000 fell short of the projected $98,079,000.

at_a_glance.headline: Software Growth Offsets Services Decline
at_a_glance.detail: The company's core software segment performed well with 4% year-over-year revenue growth to $48.8 million, helping to buffer a 3% decline in services revenue to $44.5 million.

at_a_glance.headline: Full-Year Margins and Guidance Lowered
at_a_glance.detail: Certara adjusted its full-year 2026 expectations, lowering its projected full-year revenue to a range of $367 million to $382 million and trimming its adjusted EBITDA margin to 29%-31% following its recent asset divestiture.

at_a_glance.headline: Strategic Divestiture Pressures Profits Short-Term
at_a_glance.detail: The completed divestiture of its Regulatory and Medical Writing division has pushed the business toward a higher-margin software model, but left behind stranded cost headwinds that compressed near-term margins.

at_a_glance.headline: Restructuring Aims for Cost Efficiency
at_a_glance.detail: To counteract post-divestiture stranded costs and support future margin expansion, management implemented a reduction in force affecting approximately 5% of global employees to secure $13 million in run-rate savings.

at_a_glance.headline: Market Selloff Follows Earnings Miss
at_a_glance.detail: The weak quarterly presentation and downward adjustments to full-year guidance triggered a sharp market reaction, causing Certara's stock to plunge roughly 16% in early trading.
